svg.title: 85 Predicate boundary search
svg.desc: For weights 3, 2, 2, 4, 1, 4 shipped in 3 days, capacities 4 and 5 are too slow and 6 to 16 fit. firstTrue(4, 17, fits) probes 10, 7, 5 and 6 and returns 6.
svg.text: Which capacity c ships in 3 days?
False, then true: the boundary is capacity 6.
[4, 7) probe 5: needs 4 days, too slow: low = 6
low = high = 6: the smallest capacity that fits.
Once a capacity fits, every larger one
fits: each probe halves the range.
